newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria offers 3-, 6-mo discount bills on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria offers 3-, 6-mo discount bills on Monday.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry said on Tuesday it will offer two discount T-bill issues with a total par of 12 billion levs ($6.6 million) in three- and six-month maturities at auctions on Monday.
The government securities will be offered with no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.

The maximum amount of paper a single bank can buy at the auctions through competitive bids is set at 15 percent of the par value earmarked for such bids for the three-month maturity and 35 percent for the six-month T-bills.
Of the total par on offer, 95 percent are earmarked for competitive bids and the remainder for non-competitive bids.
Par value 4.0 bln levs 8.0 bln levs
